text:
mira: Heads up — we had a customer hit pool ejection when they combined the workspace hint header with a private endpoint flag. Need a quick call on fallback semantics.

alex: Do we have the request sample? which headers exactly?

mira: They sent: `X-Workspace: acme-inc`, `X-Scope-Hint: workspace`, `X-Private-Endpoint: true`. Gateway routed to dedicated pool but then ejected after auth check failed.

juan: Ejected by which rule? my read of the code is we only eject when pool_affinity mismatch + quota breach.

sam: I saw the logs — gateway did an affinity lookup, found dedicated pool pinned to another workspace, then ran the isolation guard and returned 412 -> fallback to shared, but because `X-Private-Endpoint: true` we should not fallback, we should 403 or surface a clearer error.

mira: Right. The customer expects private endpoint to be strict. They interpret fallback as a policy leak.

alex: We need to decide two things: 1) precedence: does private endpoint flag override workspace hint? 2) if dedicated pool not available, do we fail-open (shared) or fail-closed (error)?

juan: My strong preference is fail-closed for private endpoints. Otherwise we violate isolation guarantees.

sam: Agreed. For `X-Private-Endpoint: true` we should treat it as a hard constraint. For `X-Scope-Hint` we can be best-effort.

mira: Proposed policy: if private_endpoint==true and pool_affinity mismatch -> return 403 with a specific error code `pool.isolation_violation`. If private_endpoint==false and scope_hint mismatches -> allow shared fallback with telemetry.

alex: How about a hybrid: allow an org-level setting `allow_private_fallback: true/false` for Enterprise customers who opt in. But default should be fail-closed.

juan: That seems reasonable. Also we need to add clear logs and console UX: a per-request tooltip showing "Why request failed — isolation" with link to rollout docs.

mira: For the gateway impl, simplest change is in route_resolver: reorder checks so private_endpoint check is checked before fallback resolver. Pseudocode: 

```
if request.headers["X-Private-Endpoint"] == "true":
  if pool_affinity matches workspace: route
  else: return 403, code=pool.isolation_violation
else:
  try: route to affinity pool
  except PoolMismatch: route to shared_pool (with metric)
```

sam: We'll need a migration because some customers currently rely on the old behavior. Add feature flag `gateway.fail_closed_private` default true.

alex: Also add telemetry: `isolation.ejection_count` with tags: reason, target_pool, workspace_id, config_flag. And surface a chart in console (per-tenant) under Routing -> Isolation events.

mira: UX note: console should show a small banner when an org has allowed private fallbacks, and a link to change. Avoid surprising fallbacks.

ops-bot: @channel deploy queued: `gateway/route_resolver/2026-03-18` (staging)

mira: I'll draft a short RFC with the policy, metrics, and rollout plan. TL;DR: default fail-closed for private endpoints, opt-in allow_fallback for enterprise, add clear error codes and telemetry, add console explanations.

alex: 👍 let's get the RFC up and ship the feature flag in staging.

juan: +1. I'll prototype the code reorder and unit tests for the three flows (private_fail_closed, workspace_hint_fallback, enterprise_optin).

sam: I'll add the dashboard panels and ensure alerts if `isolation.ejection_count` spikes.

mira: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Juan will open the PR, Sam will add dashboards, Alex will write the RFC. I'll tag people on the RFC when ready.
